ruling.recommended_action: Issue rider a voucher of SGD 4.34 (excess metered distance on the unexempted 3.08 km detour); no account flag (driver's 90-day upheld route disputes = 0).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is only pickup logistics; complaint and driver statement contain no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation → safety_concern none (SAFE-1/SAFE-2 not triggered).

Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and detour kilometres do feed the fare (policy §0, RD-2).

Route check: the quoted route is 21.21 km / 28.4 min; the GPS trace follows it closely (Changi-bound via ECP/airport corridor) but from ~09:25 the driver leaves the quoted line around (1.3093,103.9351)-(1.3115,103.9344), runs north-east along an unquoted corridor to ~1.3165 (09:26-09:28), doubles back south-west (09:29-09:31) and only then rejoins the quoted line near (1.3121,103.9510) at ~09:32, continuing normally to T3. Measuring the trace against the quoted polyline (local metre grid) gives ≈24.6 km driven versus 21.21 km quoted, i.e. ≈3.4 km more; separating the quoted segments from the off-route loop, the off-route segment itself is ≈3.08 km of extra distance. This is one off-route segment, well above the 0.2 km matching-noise tolerance, so per RD-1 it is an unexempted detour unless a clause excuses it.

No excuse: there is no rider message before or during the segment, nothing in the chat consents to any route change (RD-5 consent_after_or_none), no rider-named stop (RD-3), and the traffic record has no incidents at all (incidents: []) while the only speed bands on the quoted route are band 5 (free flow), so RD-4 does not apply. The driver's statement that "the GPS rerouted" is not a rider consent (a verbal claim is not consent, G11) and is not a traffic justification.

Amount (RydeTAXI, RD-2): rate per km = fare.distance_fare ÷ fare.distance_km = 34.42 ÷ 24.41 = 1.4101 SGD/km. Refund = 3.08 km × 1.4101 = 4.34 SGD (only the mileage unit; metered waiting time is not refunded, RD-3(c), and the unmatched remainder of the metre difference is not refunded, RD-2). Rider's claim of a 3 km overcharge is directionally correct; the computed figure is 3.08 km.

Flag: driver profile route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6's repeated-offender condition is not met; no flag_account.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route loop from ~(1.3093,103.9351) at 09:25:00 to rejoin at ~(1.3121,103.9510) at 09:32:00 (≈3.08 km extra): a backtracking deviation for which no rider message exists before the segment (chat has only pickup logistics) and no traffic incident supports it (incidents empty; quoted-route speed band 5). Fails RD-5 (no prior consent; driver's 'GPS rerouted' claim is not consent, G11) and RD-4. Un-exempted under RD-1 → counts under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Not a defence: no traffic incident in the record supports a reasonable-cause reroute (RD-4), and a driver's assertion of rerouting/verbal agreement is not rider consent (RD-5 + G11).

Overstated as against a measurement basis: the trace shows ≈3.4 km more than quoted in total but the isolated off-route segment is ≈3.08 km; per RD-2 only the segment's extra_km is refunded (SGD 4.34), not the whole metre-versus-quote difference.
